item.meaning: A constitutional mandate outlining civic duties, including the explicit duty of every citizen to protect and improve the natural environment, forests, lakes, rivers, and wildlife.

item.definition: The supreme legal document of India that established democratic governance, civil rights, and citizen duties, taking official effect on 26 January 1950.

item.title: Constitutional Unity and Nature Care
item.description: The Indian Constitution unites diverse cultures while establishing Article 51A, making environmental protection and compassion for wildlife a Fundamental Duty for every citizen.

item.function: Displays the currency value in 15 official regional languages, visually embodying constitutional linguistic unity in diversity.
